cases.prompt: a zebra bending down to drink water from a river
a drone flying over a snowy forest.
a zebra running to join a herd of its kind

sampling.shared: Per case: one saved FP64 initial latent, four saved FP32 update noises, one BF16 embedding; all arms load identical tensors
sampling.rng: CUDA Generator reset to fixed seed for each prompt; initial FP32 draw then four FP32 draws, including last zero-coefficient update

seed_history.claim: Same integer seed used previously; no global unseen-seed claim. The four prompt/noise generation pairs are separate from the fixed E020 train/development cache records.
seed_history.note: A seed integer also used for training shuffle is not by itself data leakage. Prompt selection comes from the E020 inventory, not scores.

comparison_scope: Whole deployed recipe comparison. SVD includes its frozen smooth/LR and legacy non-target quantization recipe; differences from plain QAD are not attributed solely to LR.
limits: Four development prompts, one seed; not a final held-out benchmark or a quality conclusion.
Candidate prompts were already in a public/planned VBench manifest; absence of prior media was checked only in inventory-listed local roots.
No E020 training/validation cache state is injected into these free rollouts.
Wall times include diagnostics; this generator is not an unbiased latency benchmark.
